policy_presence.summary: The retained scoped references are discoverable; no institution-wide semantic completion or permission is inferred.

ai_disclosure.summary: These retained UW references do not establish a general AI disclosure format or deadline. Ask what the course requires for the work you are submitting.

coursework.summary: UW leaves GenAI conditions to instructors: a course may allow, limit or prohibit use. Check the applicable instructions before using it for assessed work.

exams.summary: The retained UW course-discretion evidence does not establish a separate exam rule or permission. Check the instructions for the specific exam.

privacy_data_entry.summary: UW general guidance permits University data only in UW-approved services and applications. Approval for data handling does not establish assessment permission.

academic_integrity.summary: UW warns that using AI content generators without instructor permission may violate academic standards. This is not a finding of misconduct or a fixed penalty.

approved_tools.summary: UW tool listings remain discovery records. Current user eligibility, pricing and assessment permission have not been confirmed here.

named_ai_services.summary: Tool discovery is separate from assessment permission; current eligibility and complete product terms remain pending.

teaching_guidance.summary: Teaching@UW advises instructors to establish and communicate their course AI policy. UW also recognizes instructors’ discretion over conditions of use.

research_guidance.summary: UW Graduate School guidance is explicitly advisory. It advises researchers not to share confidential, proprietary or IP-sensitive information with AI tools.

security_procurement.summary: For University data, UW requires an approved service or application. These references do not verify product pricing, student access or a campus-wide procurement procedure.
